entry.name: Certified Artificial Intelligence Consultant (CAIC)
entry.note: A vendor-neutral consulting credential from a private certification body
entry.audience: Consultants and leaders advising organisations on AI strategy

covers: AI and ML algorithms, tools, techniques, architecture, and frameworks
Deployment and management of AI models in production
Neural networks and applications such as translation, speech recognition, and image classification
Fraud prevention with Cloud AI solutions
Development, deployment, testing, and maintenance of AI applications
reading.format: Self-paced training with study books, eLearning materials, workshops, and hands-on videos, requiring about 8 to 10 hours per week.
reading.summary: The Certified Artificial Intelligence Consultant (CAIC) is a certification from the United States Artificial Intelligence Institute for mid-level AI professionals. It focuses on leading complex AI projects and building, implementing, or scaling AI tools and infrastructures. Earning it shows ability to develop, deploy, test, and maintain AI applications, manage AI models in production, and advise on AI, machine learning, and deep learning model use.
reading.audience: It is for professionals in mid-level AI careers who want more challenging and impactful AI and machine learning consultant roles.
